Sticky 6m core PCE near 3%, positive payrolls, and hot services orders keep the tightening bias live after the 16-Sep 25bp hike; global policy (BoJ hike, BoE hike minority, energy pass-through) raises the odds that the Sep-2027 peak is not the cycle's last word.

Round-2 opponents add no new packet facts: mean-reverter restates the known hike and 99th-percentile 2Y as a fade; CAD-up seats restate BoC energy minutes and CA-US 2Y -140bp. context_build.market_implied_assumption: From 3.85% overnight, the 3m SOFR strip prices about 90.5bp of additional tightening by Sep-2027 (roughly three-and-a-half 25bp steps) and then about 21bp of easing by Jun-2029 (4.545%). Dec-26 3m at 4.32% is only +47bp — barely two additional 25bp hikes through year-end. The priced assumption is a completed-enough hiking cycle with a modest terminal near 4.75% and early, shallow cuts after the 2027 peak.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The disagreement is not that the Sep hike was missed; it is that 4.755% as the strip peak, followed by easing, is too low and too early if 6m core PCE stays near 3% with U-3 4.1%, payrolls still positive, ISM services 55.4 and orders above 60, and August retail rebounding 1.2%. A reaction function that just hiked on sticky inflation should not already be pricing the last hike into a 2027-09 peak plus cuts. SR3U7 is the contract that owns that peak. Mean-reverter's extra-73bp-is-overshoot claim and value-guy's US-down compression leg are the same priced assumption.

Marginal driver of the 2Y/SR3U7 complex is the hiking path, not term premium — 2s10s at a 1y extreme of 25bp shows the front end, not the 30Y (5.34%, +15bp 1m), did the selling. Cross-market: CA-US 2Y is -140bp (3.8th 1y percentile) because CORRA prices a larger additional hike cycle (+84bp by Mar-27, +136bp by Jun-28) from a 2.29% overnight despite cooler CA inflation/labor; that is CAD-specific energy pass-through, not evidence that US terminal is already rich, and not a reason CAD must rise versus USD while the overnight gap is 156bp.
